findings.namedBuyers: Two priority commercially relevant organizer contacts are Gaelle Delesderrier and Sen Catala, both listed for 2027 at M.I.C.E. spirit. Gaelle has event-agency/incentive expertise; Sen has a hotel background and is an agency co-founder. Their organizer status is verified, but neither is established as a room-block buyer or authorized signatory. Matthieu Robin and Matteo Mazzeri are additional organizer/co-founder escalation routes. Public shared route: geneva@devopsdays.org.
findings.futureEdition: Confirmed upcoming public conference: 25–26 May 2027, HEG Campus de Battelle, Rue de la Tambourine 17, 1227 Carouge, Geneva, Switzerland. Official welcome and ticketing agree on both dates. Material discrepancy: the HEG host listing says "Lundi 24 mai 2027 - Mercredi 26 mai 2027" and Bâtiment B. No source explains 24 May; do not sell a third conference day or assume setup/workshop demand. No official Geneva 2028 edition was located.
findings.hotelProductFit: Inference using the supplied YOTEL specifications: low-priority, conditional ancillary lodging/relationship lead, not a primary conference-venue replacement. Carouge is outside the hotel’s Founex/La Côte core territory. More than 400 historical participants exceed the supplied approximately 250-theatre plenary capacity; this is not a 2027 attendance forecast and is not a bedroom requirement. The 237 guestrooms do not imply a whole-house opportunity. Only test a modest speaker/organizer/sponsor subgroup or small independent workshop after confirming non-centralized lodging, actual nonlocal overnight demand, willingness to stay in Founex, and transport. No event-specific Geneva Airport arrival or La Côte lodging evidence was found. Do not assume catering scale or claim a 20–120-room block exists.
findings.venueCommitments: Published 2027 venue commitment is HEG Campus de Battelle at the above address; host institution specifies Bâtiment B. Organizer location page: "The event will be taking place at: HEG Campus de Battelle". This is an educational campus, not an incumbent hotel. Territory classification: Geneva urban area, specifically Carouge, Canton of Geneva; not Founex/Nyon/La Côte/Geneva Airport corridor, Lausanne or French Pays de Gex. Publication confirms the announced host, not access to a signed venue contract.
findings.historicalRotation: Stable host, not a rotating destination: official archives list the same HEG/Campus de Battelle address for 2019, 2020 and every held edition from 2022 through 2026. The 2021 edition was explicitly canceled. Recurrence is verified by editions, not an uninterrupted annual guarantee. Calendar dates changed; no destination or hotel rotation was found. See historicalEditions for exact dates and sources.
findings.accommodationSourcing: Unknown for 2027. No edition-specific host hotel, hotel list, published room block, housing bureau, hotel RFP, peak-room figure or room-night figure was found on the reviewed official welcome, location, ticketing and sponsor pages. Every listed hotel: none found. Venue statement quotes the campus only, not lodging. Ticketing says the event "will be held at the Geneva School of Management". M.I.C.E. spirit organizers are identified, but that does not establish an exclusive housing mandate. Silence is not evidence of open hotel sourcing or individual booking.
findings.organizationStructure: Community-run technical conference, not a verified corporate incentive programme. Official devopsdays About page: "Each event is run by volunteers from the local area" and "Organization is decentralized. Local events handle their own sponsorships, registration, and all other organization." HEG is the host institution, not proven hotel buyer. M.I.C.E. spirit is an event agency represented on the organizer team; its legal ownership of this event and any delegated housing/procurement authority are unverified. Geneva legal contracting entity is not published in reviewed sources.
findings.competitiveLimitations: HEG is the announced 2027 meeting venue and repeatedly hosts this event; replacing it is not a substantiated opportunity. No incumbent lodging hotel, competing room rate, sold-out inventory, compression, waiting list or overflow requirement was found. Historical attendance: M.I.C.E. spirit’s own 29 May 2026 post says "Plus de 400 participants"; its posts reproduced on Evepla report "430 passionnés réunis" on 26 May 2026 and "plus de 430 participants" on 21 May. Use >400 as primary-source historical evidence; 430 is a secondary reproduction, not a 2027 forecast. Regional attendance does not establish overnight conversion.
findings.recommendedSalesAction: Send one targeted qualification email to geneva@devopsdays.org for Gaelle Delesderrier and Sen Catala. Ask who handles lodging, whether any bureau/exclusive allocation or contracted hotels exist (request all hotel names), whether there is a nonlocal speaker/sponsor subgroup, actual peak rooms/nights and budget, and whether Founex plus a transport solution is acceptable. Clarify the HEG 24–26 May versus organizer 25–26 May discrepancy and whether 24 May generates any paid activity. Only if lodging is independently sourced and a subgroup accepts the location, offer a small, release-controlled accommodation proposal; otherwise park 2027 and cultivate the agency relationship. Do not buy sponsorship merely to access a supposed hotel opportunity.
findings.currentEditionAccessibility: For the upcoming 2027 edition, the conference venue is already announced elsewhere; hotel sourcing remains unconfirmed, neither open nor proven committed to another hotel. The organizer email is public. Sales accessibility is a qualification conversation only, not a validated room-block/RFP lead. Do not position YOTEL as primary Geneva conference housing without proof that lodging is not centrally contracted and that the group accepts the Founex location.
findings.futureCompetitiveCapturePotential: Inference: relationship-led access to later speaker/sponsor lodging or a separately commissioned small workshop may be worth testing, especially through the agency organizers. Stable campus hosting argues against pitching a future full-event relocation. No 2028 dates, venue move, accommodation tender or future hotel buying cycle was located; do not promote future competitive capture as a confirmed edition or pipeline room demand.
